definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう} (anzen hoshou, security). Most commonly refers to the US-Japan Security Treaty ({日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}) or national security policy in general. Frequently appears in news and political discussion.

examples.japanese: {安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}が{改定|かいてい}された。
{安保|あんぽ}に{関|かん}する{議論|ぎろん}が{活発|かっぱつ}になっている。
examples.english: Debate about security has been intensifying.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}は{戦後|せんご}の{日本|にほん}{外交|がいこう}の{基盤|きばん}となっている。
examples.english: The US-Japan security alliance has been the foundation of postwar Japanese diplomacy.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of {安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}. In Japanese political discourse, {安保|あんぽ} most often refers to the US-Japan Security Treaty ({日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}). The {安保|あんぽ}{闘争|とうそう} (Anpo protests) of 1960 were massive demonstrations against the treaty's renewal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}: US-Japan security alliance
- {安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}: security treaty
- {安保|あんぽ}{理事会|りじかい}: Security Council (of the UN)
- {安保|あんぽ}{法制|ほうせい}: security legislation
